thread:
emma: Heads-up — finalizing release notes for docs site (v0.9.4-docs). Need small fixes: python SDK auth snippet, embeddings migration example, and a couple of anchor redirects. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4701
nate: Can you paste the known-issues short list? I'll triage blockers.
emma: Known issues:
- Old embed-streaming example still referenced in quickstart.
- Python snippet uses Client(auth_token=...) pattern; SDK changed to AuthContext.
- Some internal anchors broke after heading reshuffle in deploy/regions.md.
olivia: I'll take the embed example replacement — will add a 3-line old->new sample and point to migration guide. PR incoming.
nate: I'll handle the anchor redirects and add the anchor-checker step to the relnotes workflow. Which file runs checks currently?
docs-bot: anchor-checker runs on main only. Recommend adding to .github/workflows/release-notes.yml to run for relnotes branches.
emma: Do that and post the PR link. For the python snippet, prefer to ship doc now with a compatibility callout "Requires SDK >= 0.6.2" rather than blocking publish.
olivia: Agreed. PR #4703 opened for embed snippet and migration blurb. Added TODO to remove old quickstart line.
nate: PR #4705 opened with anchor fixes and workflow tweak. I also included a small redirect in _redirects.yml for /embed-streaming -> /docs/migration/embed-streaming.
build-bot: CI queued for PRs: #4701 (relnotes), #4703 (embed migration), #4704 (python snippet), #4705 (anchors).
emma: PR #4704 (python snippet) created: "docs: update python auth snippet". Added compatibility banner above snippet. Please keep description starting with docs:.
nate: Local link-check passed after redirects. Pushed fixes to #4705.
olivia: Left a short migration paragraph in relnotes: "Embeddings: embed streaming is deprecated; follow the migration guide for updated call shapes and code samples."
emma: Dan asked for two tiny marketing-safe bullets — added: "Dedicated: burst pools support mixed CPU/GPU allocations for better cost predictability." and "Latency SLO: median latency improved; no API changes." Kept the lines < 120 chars.
docs-bot: Reminder: Once relnotes PR #4701 merges, schedule publish using .github/workflows/publish-docs.yml with tag v0.9.4-docs.
emma: Final step: everyone add a one-line PR title starting with "docs:" so the changelog generator picks entries. I'll merge after CI is green and aim to publish at 06:00 UTC tomorrow. Thanks! :rocket:
